name: Vibe Coding Studio
description: A governed application workspace for turning business ideas into traceable websites and apps while keeping requirements, architecture, code, tests, deployment evidence, and approvals connected.
product_outcome: Enable repeatable idea-to-release app delivery with visible scope, risks, decisions, quality evidence, and operational ownership.

runtime.platform: platform-agnostic adapters for supported coding and hosting environments
runtime.environment: separate development, preview, staging, and production environments

data_classification: Confidential by default; each project must classify data and enforce least-privilege access before ingestion.

deployment.default: No production deployment without accountable approval.

test_plan: Validate critical journeys, authorization boundaries, data handling, integrations, accessibility, responsive behavior, performance, failure recovery, migrations, observability, and rollback before production approval.
